title: REQ · Scene content declares moonlight shaft, lamp glow, door light and vignette with palette colours
summary: Effect schema and bedroom.yaml carry the four new lighting effects
description: Context: effectSchema in game/src/content/schema.ts is a discriminated union of dust, ambientLight and transition. Desired: add moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette variants and author them in bedroom.yaml with palette hex colours. Expected result: the bedroom validates and lists six non-transition effects. Why: effects must be data-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with a moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette effect, when validated, then it passes
Given a lampGlow with a negative radius, when validated, then validation fails with a path starting effects.0
Given the bedroom scene, when loaded, then its effect types include moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette and every colour is in PALETTE

preserve: dust, ambientLight and transition schema variants

technical_constraints: One shared palette of at most 48 colours
